scope: Exposed development, half-risk candidate vs human classical diagnostic; paired allocation conditions, no price fitting/Elo/holdout/default claim.

declaration.question: Does equal-time root allocation help the fixed half-risk candidate against classical leaf on actual play?
declaration.trigger: Root28 changes e5c6 to e5d3 under MultiPV3 with favorable finite child reference; not an isolated evaluation repair.
declaration.design: 24streams: two existing6ply prefixes x three unchanged tables x both candidate colors x SinglePV1/MultiPV3. Classical SinglePV1 throughout. Fresh engines/hash/cell, local1sec Threads1 Hash16 NNUEfalse,160subsequentplies. Sequential alternating allocation; no extra budget for candidate.
declaration.match_policy: Explicit claim_chess_draws=True; automatic outcomes first and prospective legal claim witness unplayed. Library material detection not exhaustive dead position. Core defaults unchanged.
declaration.decision: All tables retained; not price selection/Elo/holdout/strength or default promotion. If allocation does not improve practical feedback, do not blindly add breadth; inspect actionable game failure.
declaration.cost: <=3840 requested local seconds plus Core/logging; interruptible after every action. One game at a time, no other timed experiments.

declaration.question: Does the first geometric candidate loss expose early evaluation/allocation weakness?
declaration.selection: First geometric loss, early b2b4/king exposure, midgame h2h4, later h4h5 before own first material collapse. Chosen from recorded trajectory, exposed diagnostic; all retained.
declaration.conditions: exchange SinglePV1/MultiPV3 and classical SinglePV1, each fresh1sec Threads1 Hash16 NNUEfalse; same full history/prices. Full reference root/unique children500000nodes/1sec fresh hash. Finite cp/mate not WDL.
declaration.decision: If allocation rescues a materially worse choice, compare allocation in actual games. If not, inspect concrete leaf failure rather than broad SEE framework.
declaration.cost: 9local calls plus <=15finite-reference calls/replay; no concurrency with timed games.
